newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE to announce Miyakoshi, SNT outstanding volume.
newsitem.headline: TSE to announce Miyakoshi, SNT outstanding volume.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Friday that it would announce the outstanding volume of margin trades in shares of Miyakoshi Corp and SNT Corp, starting with orders placed on September 20.
TSE officals said the outstanding volume of volatile shares are sometimes announced as a precautionary measure for investors.

In the Friday session, audio and video equipment manufacturer Miyakoshi's shares hit their maximum allowable single-day gain in the Friday afternoon session, climbing 100 yen to 600 yen. SNT rose 30 yen to 1,450 yen.
TSE also said that it would would stop announcing the outstanding volume of Kanto Special Steel. The shares were last traded at 520 yen, down 15 yen.
